thread.title: Amazon Looks To Advance Smart Home Technology| Investor's Business Daily

author: BRIAN DEAGON
title: Amazon Looks To Advance Smart Home Technology| Investor's Business Daily
text:
As it looks to gain momentum in smart home technology, Amazon ( AMZN ) on Tuesday said it invested in Plant Prefab, a maker of prefabricated custom single-family and multifamily houses.
X
The investment was made through Amazon's Alexa Fund , which provides venture capital funding to fuel voice-connected smart home technology. The $6.7 million funding round was joined by Obvious Ventures, a firm co-founded by Evan Williams, a co-founder of Twitter.
"Voice has emerged as a delightful technology in the home, and there are now more than 20,000 Alexa-compatible smart home devices from 3,500 different brands," said Paul Bernard, director of the Alexa Fund, in a statement.
The investments comes as Amazon, last week, announced a bevy of new products that expands its line of Echo smart speakers and connections to smart-home devices, all controlled via the artificially intelligent Alexa.

Please contact customer service CLOSE Smart speakers, such as the Echo line of products, are becoming the central communication hub of smart homes. The e-commerce giant is in a race with Google-owner Alphabet ( GOOGL ) to lead the market. Amazon leads the smart-speaker category , with 70% U.S. market share. Google Home is second with a 24% share. Apple ( AAPL ) is third at 6%, with its Apple HomePod.
Amazon Working With Lennar Based in Rialto, Calif., Plant Prefab was spun out of LivingHomes , a design and development company that also builds prefabricated homes, in 2016. The startup is focusing on using automation to build homes faster and bring down costs.
Amazon already has a deal with Lennar ( LENB ), the nation's largest homebuilder, to pre-install Alexa devices in all the company's new homes, announced in May. Lennar said its new homes will include built-in Wi-Fi, smart locks, thermostats and lights controlled by Alexa.
Shares of Amazon closed at 1,974.55, up 2% on the stock market today .
